info.name: FitOS API — Phase 1 + Phase 2
info.description:
Full FitOS backend API (Accounts/Onboarding §1 + Gym Owner Module §2).

**Getting started:** run `auth > POST /auth/register` (or `/auth/login`) first — its test script auto-saves `accessToken` into the collection variables, so every other request is authenticated automatically. Fill path variables (`gymId`, `enrollmentId`, …) in the collection variables tab, or per-request.

Every success response is wrapped `{ success, data, timestamp }`; errors are `{ statusCode, error, message, path, timestamp }`.

Generated from the live OpenAPI spec.

Confirm an email address using the token from the verification email.

request.description: Create a gym. The caller becomes its GYM_OWNER.
Create an invite code for staff/trainers/members to join this gym.
Revoke an invite code.
Add a single walk-in member (§2.1) — finds-or-creates the person and attaches a MEMBER role. Use /members/import for bulk CSV.

Bulk-import members from parsed register/spreadsheet rows. Tolerant per-row validation — bad rows are reported, not fatal. Pass dryRun:true to preview without writing. The client parses CSV/Excel and sends raw row objects (see BulkImportMembersDto for recognized columns).
Rotate the secret embedded in the printed self-check-in QR (§2.3) — invalidates a leaked/photographed poster.
Redeem an invite code to join a gym in the role it grants.
Get gym profile. Requires active membership at this gym.
List invite codes for this gym.
List gym members/staff, optionally filtered by role.
360° member view: profile, recent enrollments with computed dues, recent attendance.
Update gym profile (owner/manager only).
Private front-desk/owner notes about this person.
Staff edits: photo, ID proof, emergency contact (§2.1).
Trainer roster: shift schedule + commission rate config (§2.8).
Remove a member/staff record from this gym.
Create a membership plan template (part of the gym setup wizard).
List the gym's active membership plans.
Update a membership plan.
Deactivate (retire) a plan — soft delete so purchase history survives.
Submit a certification for verification.
[Super admin] List certifications awaiting verification review.
Get the current user's trainer profile and certifications.
[Super admin] Approve or reject a submitted certification.
Update trainer bio, specializations, experience, intro video.
Start the gym's SaaS plan trial.
Start the 7-day member premium trial (3 days full access, 4 days limited).
[Super admin] List all trial-duration configs.
Get the gym's current subscription and trial phase.
Get the current user's subscription and trial phase.

The caller's feature-gating truth (§1.5): tier + which premium features are unlocked. Tracking/history is free forever; aiPlans, trainerChat, and nutritionAnalysis gate behind trial/premium. FE drives all paywall UI off this response.
[Super admin] Create/update trial durations for a plan code (§1.5 configurability).

Get a signed PUT URL for direct-to-storage upload (Supabase Storage). Flow: call this, PUT the file bytes to uploadUrl with the requiredHeaders, then submit publicUrl to the endpoint that expects the file (e.g. POST /trainers/me/certifications). 503 until storage is configured.
Whether media storage is configured (FE can hide upload UI when false).
Enroll a member in a plan (§2.1). Pass couponCode to apply a discount.
Assign a PT/class pack to a specific trainer (§2.8).
Upgrade/downgrade — auto-prorates unused value from the old plan as a credit.
Freeze/hold an active enrollment.
Renew — creates the next enrollment, starting when this one ends (or now, if already lapsed).
Consume one session from a PT/class pack.
Reassign this enrollment to a different member (no money math).
Resume a frozen enrollment — extends endDate by the actual frozen duration.

query.description: Only ACTIVE enrollments whose endDate falls within this many days from now.

request.description: List enrollments. Filter by status, userId, or expiringWithinDays.
Get one enrollment.
List sessions consumed against a PT/class pack.
Correct price/dueDate/notes on an enrollment.
Record a cash/UPI-off-platform payment (§2.2, gateway-free scope).
Void a payment (owner/manager only — closes the fraud vector of front desk voiding cash they collected).
List payments — a financial report, owner/manager only (front desk can collect but not browse).
Non-GST manual receipt for a payment.
Dues dashboard: who owes what — owner/manager only.
Google-Calendar-style manual entry: add/backfill attendance for a specific date (§2.3).
Self check-in by scanning the gym's printed QR (§2.3).
Front-desk check-in fallback for today.
Calendar view — list attendance entries, filter by date range and/or member.
"X hasn't come in N days" — the seed of the churn engine (§2.3).
Attendance history for one member.
Edit a calendar attendance entry (time/notes).
Delete a calendar attendance entry — owner/manager only (can hide fraud/absence otherwise).
Create a coupon code (§2.4).
List the gym's coupons.
List redemptions for campaign tracking.
Update a coupon.
Deactivate a coupon — soft delete so redemption history survives.
Redeem a friend's referral code — reward grants once your first purchase qualifies it.
Get the current referral reward configuration.
Get (or mint) your shareable referral code.
Referrals you have made and their status.
Set this gym's referral reward configuration (§2.5).
Get (or mint) your own platform-referral code.
All owner-referral redemptions, for ops to apply the reward manually.
Gyms created using your referral code.
Capture a lead (§2.6) — walk-in, phone, Instagram/website form.
Log a follow-up outcome.
Convert a lead to a member (find-or-create the person, attach MEMBER role). Enroll them in a plan separately via /memberships.
List leads, kanban-filterable by stage/source/assignee.
Get one lead.
Follow-up history for a lead.
Trial-conversion metrics: counts by stage/source, overall conversion rate.
Move stage, reassign, edit notes/follow-up date.
Confirm a queued WhatsApp outbox item was actually sent (staff tapped the wa.me link).
Broadcast an announcement (§2.9). Reliable delivery is EMAIL-only at gym scale — WhatsApp queues one wa.me link per recipient in the outbox, which does not scale to large member lists.
The staff outbox (§2.9): WhatsApp reminders queue here as wa.me tap-to-send links (no paid WhatsApp Business API yet). Filter ?status=QUEUED to see what's pending.
Monthly: revenue, active members, renewals vs churn, attendance trend.
Today: check-ins, collections, new joins, expiring soon, dues (§2.7). Owner/manager only.
Trainer roster and assigned-client counts.
